paragraphs: The Velar P400e is a petrol plug-in hybrid (PHEV) variant of the Range Rover Velar, introduced in 2018 as part of the L560 generation. Its powertrain combines a 2.0-litre Ingenium AJ200P four-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor. The P400e received a significant update in 2024, which included a larger, more efficient 19.2kWh battery pack and 50kW charging capability, boosting the combined output to 400bhp and 472lb-ft. The AJ200P petrol engine forms the internal combustion part of this system, and our rebuild services cover this component. Range Rover Velar P400e Engine Compatibility Because the Velar P400e is a plug-in hybrid, the petrol engine is integrated with the electric motor and battery system. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Velar P400e from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
